overlap_context.resident_cache_reject_reason: 83.211GiB combined gate+up+down tensor payload is far above spare VRAM and would also violate the 16GB host/page-cache goal if mirrored in RAM.

streaming_bound.interpretation: Even ideal sequential pack/read does not reduce the up/down repeated logical payload unless it also changes compute/dataflow. At 64GiB/s, up/down repeated movement alone is about 14.8s across the dev-set trace before kernel/sync/D2H/page-cache overhead; combined with gate misses it is about 17.0s. This is only a bandwidth floor, not an achievable runtime.

decision.reason: Overlap is 100%, but combining reads does not reduce bytes enough. Full resident cache is impossible, and pure streaming still has a large transfer floor plus GPU compute and remaining down/up scheduling overhead. Prior pack/hotset/cache probes show that stealing gate cache regresses token rate.
decision.allowed_followup: Only a compare-only or hard-bound design that reduces payload footprint or fuses compute without extra long-lived cache should proceed. A pack may still be useful for cold gate miss locality, but not as a standalone route to generalized >5 tok/s.
